gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla is a classic serif with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Nulshock stretches out wide and technical in a thin, unshaded outline, while the body text stays refined and authoritative.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-pridi: Pridi is a classic serif whose small letters stand proud, nearly capital-sized, with generous gaps where curves meet stems. Nulshock, by contrast, traces every stroke at one stylus width, so the long reading feels refined and unhurried beneath it.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-scope-one: Big x-height and stubby ascenders give Scope One a traditional, spilled-open look on the line. Scope One would feel oversized if enlarged, and Nulshock, with its neon-glass tubing, would lose its glow if shrunk small.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-suwannaphum: Nulshock stretches its tube-like letters wide, with round forms as heavy as the straight ones and a technical, bold stance. Suwannaphum answers with dignified, high-standing lowercase.
gen-dafont-nulshock-inter: Inter is a sans-serif with big, breathing counters and a tall lowercase that looks smooth as a tube. Enlarge it freely, while Nulshock stays stretched and technical.
gen-dafont-nulshock-mulish: Mulish is modern and approachable, with no thick-and-thin modulation and apertures like a horseshoe magnet's open end. Mulish gives Nulshock's stretched, technical outline a friendly, large-x-height partner to lean against.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-archivo: Round and commanding, Oldtimer draws its forms like open parentheses with no calligraphic swell on any downstroke. Archivo follows with outward-opening curves and a tall x-height, an editorial, approachable plain sans partner.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-asap: Oldtimer draws classic, commanding round forms with a thread of ink that never swells or tapers. And Asap, a readable sans, keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, so it earns its keep big and short up top.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-epilogue: Curvy, wire-like Epilogue gives a tall-bodied lowercase to Oldtimer's round, parenthesis-like forms, which sit moderate in height above it. The gap in lowercase height is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-merriweather-sans: Sturdy is the feel of Merriweather Sans, whose tall lowercase makes words look large and whose e opens clearly to the right. Oldtimer's moderate, round, classic forms sit lower, and that height gap is the pair's strongest quality.
